outcome: Course of COVID-19 disease in pregnant women
Spread of disease in healthcare settings
cohort: The review synthesizes literature concerning pregnant women affected by COVID-19.
finding: While over 90% of pregnant women with COVID-19 recover without serious morbidity, rapid disease deterioration and higher rates of obstetric complications may be observed, emphasizing the need for an individualized, multidisciplinary management approach.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery should be performed only for obstetric indications.
